metadata.title: Water Main Breaks
metadata.description: Main breaks happen year-round. There are many contributing factors including: Pipe Age, Pipe Material and Soil Conditions, and Temperature. See Water outages and main breaks for more information.

scope.method: Source geometries intersect original official community polygons. Boundary-crossing assets can belong to multiple communities.

schema.label: BREAK_TYPE
schema.description:
A - Full Circular
B - Split
C - Corrosion
D - Fitting
E - Joint
F - Diagonal Crack
G - Hole
S - Saddle

metadata.outputFormat: GeoJSON FeatureCollection; original geometry field moved to feature.geometry; source number columns converted from numeric strings to JSON numbers.
limits: Historic break records are not current outage reports.
Break points do not include a public water main globalid; exact pipe associations are not asserted.
metadata.featureId: Generated local identifier from record content hash and duplicate occurrence; not a City asset identifier.
